source.title: Process Piping - ASME Code for Pressure Piping, B31
source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads, printed folios and edition change markers are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null.

title: Example 2: Sustained Load Condition Listing
notes: (1) Sustained Condition 1, the ambient condition, includes only pipe weight and insulation weight without fluid contents or internal pressure.
(2) Sustained Condition 2 reflects the support scenario of the ambient condition, excludes thermal effects, and includes internal pressure, pipe weight, insulation weight, and fluid weight.
(3) Sustained Condition 3 reflects the support scenario of the operating condition, excludes thermal effects, and includes internal pressure, pipe weight, insulation weight, and fluid weight.
